task: Implement cleanup_session for the API gateway without using the auth service cleanup.

candidate_memories.content: API gateway cleanup_session removes the session token from the gateway-level rate limit tracker.
Gateway cleanup is concerned only with rate limit state; it does not invalidate tokens.
Gateway session cleanup must complete synchronously during the logout request handler.
When cleanup_session spans gateway and auth, confirm which system owns token invalidation.
Auth service: cleanup_session invalidates the session token and removes all associated refresh tokens.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: auth token invalidation is not the responsibility of the API gateway cleanup

candidate_memories.content: Old security note says session cleanup should be unified so logout hits a single endpoint.
